## 5. Family Pension  
- (a) A Central Government servant drawing Pay in Pay Matrix at Level 8 of ~ 74,300 from 1-8-2024 died on 31-10-2024 while in service. His date of birth is 6-6-1965. His family is eligible for payment of family pension as detailed below:-
- (i) At enhanced rate from 1-11-2024 to
- 31-10-2034
- onwards.
